British TV Actor Richard O'Sullivan Dies at 82

British actor Richard O'Sullivan, known for his role in the sitcom "Man About the House," has died at the age of 82. The show, which aired in the 1970s, was a popular British television program. O'Sullivan's death was reported by multiple outlets, with tributes emerging for the television icon.
